product.description: This gray upholstered sofa couch brings a stylish charm to any living or family room. Durable fabric-covered foam seat cushions provide lasting comfort, and the modern design complements any decor. There is plenty of room for friends and family or to stretch out and watch a movie. This item is made to order just for you. Overall: 80"W x 36"D x 34"H; seat height: 22"H; seat depth: 20"D; seat back height: 12"H; arm height: 24"H; leg height: 5.625"H Sturdy wood frame and legs; life-friendly performance fabric; foam seat cushions Removable and reversible seat and back cushions ensure durability and comfort. Vacuum or wipe with a dry cloth. Spot clean if needed. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
